caption: The drawing shows a single garment in the center, depicted as a light brown or tan coat with long, full sleeves gathered at the cuffs, and paired with matching trousers. The coat features a double row of gold-colored buttons running vertically down the front and has two side pockets. The coat is worn open at the lower part, revealing the matching straight-legged trousers underneath. The collar is rounded and neckline is cut simply. There is a sketch in the upper right corner, outlined in plain lines without color, providing a back view of the same outfit. The coat in the back view shows similar sleeve fullness and length, and the back section of the coat is split and flares out slightly. The background of the drawing is plain, uncolored, and uncluttered.
title: Boy's Suit
